## Life Summary

Hannah Baker was born on 28 August 1855 at Peachy Belt, South Australia. She married William Humphrey Parker on 21 August 1878 at the residence of her parents, Virginia, South Australia. She was the mother of at least three children, including William Henry Parker (who married Caroline Edna Lawrie).

She died on 6 October 1948 at Lower Mitcham, South Australia.
